episodes.title: Sideways Brain - How Alexandra Slipped Into — and Out of — a Cult - Sideways Brain
episodes.description:
Cult survivor Alexandra Menna joins Sideways Brain to reveal how she was recruited at age 16 into the School of Enlightenment — a high‑control group led by a woman claiming to channel a 35,000‑year‑old being. Alexandra explains cult tactics like love‑bombing, isolation, information control, guilt, fear, and loaded language, and how these methods quietly reshape a person’s identity.

She also shares how 9/11 became the turning point that helped her break free, and what the long process of deprogramming and healing looks like years later.

Topics:
• How cults recruit vulnerable people
• Psychological manipulation and coercive control
• Love‑bombing and isolation
• Information control and gaslighting
• Leaving a cult and rebuilding your life
• Survivor insights and recovery

If you’re interested in cult psychology, manipulation tactics, or real stories of escape and resilience, this episode is for you.
